requirements.notes: AUTOMATED and this change's crux. SIGN CONVENTION (authoritative = the engine's): a POSITIVE remainder ⇒ dimension is OVER the grid ⇒ round DOWN; a NEGATIVE remainder ⇒ UNDER the grid ⇒ round UP. For the kitchen 3800×2500 at M=700 the engine returns length +300 (round down) and width −300 (round up). This change (a) added gridRoundDirection encoding that convention and (b) corrected a stale reversed RoomGrid doc comment in lib/calculations.ts (comment-only; returned values were always correct). IMPORTANT DOC DRIFT: the DESIGN §6.3 worked-example table lists the kitchen signs REVERSED (−300/+300); the shipped/authoritative values are the engine's (+300/−300) and the spec.md scenarios + tests use the engine signs. During Apply the Maker caught and fixed a test/spec that had copied DESIGN's reversed signs. All three fresh Checkers verified the convention internally consistent across gridRoundDirection, computeRoomGrid, the corrected comment, the frozen prototype (prototype.dc.html:677), and spec.md — verdict clean, strict PASS. The annotation DOM render is manual (ADR-0001); the direction logic and signs are fully pinned.
